title: Quick Pickled Korean Cucumbers Banchan
description: A citrusy and snappy Korean side dish featuring pickled cucumbers, perfect for a date night, with a focus on ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients. This banchan is served in a cazuela vessel.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, water, sugar, and salt until the sugar and salt are dissolved.
Add the sliced cucumbers, green chili peppers, garlic, and ginger to the bowl and toss to combine.
Let the mixture sit at room temperature for at least 30 minutes to allow the cucumbers to pickle.
After 30 minutes, stir in the sesame oil.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.
Just before serving, give the pickled cucumbers a good stir and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Serve the pickled cucumbers in a cazuela vessel, garnished with additional green chili peppers if desired.
